results.title: Why GTA 6 renders at 720p on the Xbox Series S and still shows a 1080p picture: what FSR 4 upscaling does, and why all four console versions are upscaled
results.description: GTA 6 renders at 720p on Xbox Series S and FSR 4 scales it to 1080p. The other three versions are also upscaled. Digital Foundry saw mid-20s drops on Series S.

results.title: GTA 6 pushed UK PlayStation download requests to 8.6 times their normal level at launch, Cloudflare says, and New Zealand peaked at 14.8 times shortly before its own midnight unlock, which the BBC reads as players switching regions to start early
results.description: Cloudflare says UK PlayStation download requests hit 8.6x at GTA 6 launch. New Zealand hit 14.8x shortly before unlock, which the BBC reads as region switching.
